title: Burning Obsession: A Stalking in MD
original_title: Burning Obsession: A Stalking in MD
overview: What began as an arson investigation in Severna Park, Maryland, became something far more disturbing — a story involving fear, unanswered questions, and a family’s fight to be heard. After the Johnson family became victims of arson, stalking, and harassment, they found themselves navigating a system they trusted to protect them while searching for accountability and the truth.
